physicalNotes: No radius or mass of MACS J1149 is recorded here: its package frames it at 576,550 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), half the short side of its picture at its distance, a presentation value.

sources.position: NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database (NED), MACS J1149.5+2223: position from 2011MNRAS.410.1939Z, redshift from 2025A&A...693A...2S (https://ned.ipac.caltech.edu/byname?objname=MACS%20J1149.5%2B2223); NED preferred values of MACS J1149.5+2223: RA 177.3962208°, Dec 22.40303889° (2011MNRAS.410.1939Z); redshift 0.5421990921 ± 0.00047 (2025A&A...693A...2S)
sources.distance: Comoving distance of the redshift z = 0.5421990921 (NED, 2025A&A...693A...2S) in the Planck 2018 cosmology: 2086405931.0445287 pc, from Astropy 8.0.1 Planck18.comoving_distance (Planck Collaboration 2020, A&A 641, A6, https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.06209). The project's convention for objects placed by redshift (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
sources.properMotion: Zero: the object is held at its published position; no motion across the sky is applied.
